plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Psychology AA-T Degree' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published September 23, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7923/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: Cal-GETC. Total Units 60 = 15+15+15+15 (semester sums verified). Degree rule (per map): a minimum of 6 units (two classes) from PSYC 320, PSYC 340, PSYC 356, and PSYC 371, including either PSYC 320 or PSYC 371 as one of the two — the Semester 2 choice (PSYC 320 or PSYC 371) and Semester 3 choice (PSYC 371, PSYC 340, or PSYC 356; map suggests PSYC 371) together satisfy this. The Semester 4 Cal-GETC Area 4 slot must be a non-PSYC course, per the map. PSYC 312 meets Cal-GETC Areas 5B & 5C. Advisory (PSYC C1000: ENGRD 310, ENGRD 312, ENGL C1000, or equivalent) is a recommendation only, recorded in choice_note, never as prereq.
